transcription: Transcribed by Claude from the original screenshots on 2026-10-14; must be independently checked by a human before it counts as golden data.

source.provided: original files from the game's screenshot folder (file names kept in conditions.originalFile)
source.redaction: Lossless block wipe with jpegtran -wipe (libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5) over the CURRENT BALANCE value, one rectangle per view; every pixel outside it is identical to the original.

location.note: The YOUR INVENTORIES field shows 'Levski' with the sub-category placeholder 'Select Sub-Category' in every capture.

theme: grey and teal, all-caps font in the shop panel, mixed case in the inventory field (Nyx style)

localisation.note: The game's language file in use when the captures were taken. It is game content and is not committed; it lives in the private corpus next to the originals.

views.v1: front view, shop panel about 670 px wide (21:05:56 to 21:07:18)
views.v2: closer front view, shop panel about 960 px wide (21:08:21 to 21:09:37)
views.v3: oblique view from the left at a larger distance; the whole kiosk is in the frame and the panel is visibly skewed (21:10:51 to 21:12:25)

observations: Three views of the same terminal within about seven minutes: a front view (v1), a closer front view (v2) and an oblique view (v3). Every value common to the views is identical except Agricium (LOW INVENTORY 86 SCU in v1, VERY LOW INVENTORY 70 SCU in v2 and v3).

SELLABLE CARGO is expanded. In v1 it is empty; in v2 and v3 it holds one card, Ranta Dung (0 SCU, OUT OF STOCK, 39,000/SCU), the same values as its IN DEMAND card. The inventory panel lists Ranta Dung (6 units) in the player's inventory in every view, so the SELLABLE CARGO card is likely the player's cargo; its values equal the terminal's demand row (A21).
Corundum (1 SCU, smallest container 1) is drawn dimmed in v1 and v3, against the hypothesis that a card is dimmed only when the stock is below the smallest container size (A14). In v2 it is hovered.
Aluminum (32 SCU), Cobalt (12 SCU) and Steel (415 SCU) show OUT OF STOCK with stock on the sell side; such cards are why the screen rule 'Out of Stock => 0 SCU' was dropped (O-131).
Long names wrap inside a word: SHIP DECOY / NOISE COUNTERMEASURES are drawn as 'COUNTERMEASU' and 'RES' on separate lines.
The inventory panel on the left shows the player's goods with QUALITY values; it is not the shop panel and never counts.
Beradom, Feynmaline, Glacosite, Kopion Horn, Marok Gem, Savrilium, Lindinium, Torite, Aslarite and Pressurized Ice are drawn without a commodity icon.
The buy cards show SHOP QUANTITY; the sell cards do not.
UEX lists Beryl and Iron on the buy side here; neither appears under IN STOCK, and OUT OF STOCK stays collapsed in every capture, so whether they are listed there is not visible.

Seven sell prices differ from UEX's latest values on the capture day (Atlasium 97,000 against 92,000, Cobalt 22,000/23,000, Compboard 35,000/37,000, Audio-Visual Equipment 38,000/39,000, Gold 28,000/26,000, Iodine 12,000/13,000, Stims 5,200/5,300); each reads the same in all three views.

Captured with the game's screenshot key while Windows HDR and the game's HDR were on (stated by the project owner). The files are 8-bit baseline JPEGs without an ICC profile, so the game tone-maps the HDR frame to SDR when it saves; how it does that is unmeasured (A16), and transfer stays null.
